notes: Memory: note store with full-text recall and optional vector recall, a deterministic project brief, REST under /v1/memory/* and an in-process memory MCP upstream (profile direct:memory).
Adapters for Claude Code, Codex CLI and Warp (project brief at session start, recall on prompt, handoff on stop).
Console pages for memory (notes, brief, retract) and agent setup (mints tokens with the right scopes).
Hardening: idempotent Hindsight retain, recall-side redaction, spool items that fail are parked instead of stopping capture, free-space check fails closed.
Encrypted raw archive: transcripts stored as age ciphertext; the server holds no decryption key and no decrypt code.
Retention sweeper that removes a local transcript only after proving the same bytes are archived, replicated offsite and recoverable.
Consistent database snapshots (admin db-snapshot) used by the nightly backup.
Console at /console/: password plus authenticator code login, optional GitHub sign-in, token and upstream management, audit view.
Vault key for stored secrets (admin vault-init). Without it the gateway still runs and the console stays off.
Public HTTPS behind a reverse proxy, token scope editing (token scopes), GitHub MCP as a third upstream.

Review pass: bounded audit rows, one POST is one JSON-RPC message, upstream redirects never followed, bearer attached only to the upstream's own host, response bodies capped at 8 MiB, stale tool lists served while one refresh runs.
